prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore to restore deleted episodes with their cuts at their previous position, an Undo action on the Episodes page delete toast in both languages, and backend tests.

+from uuid import uuid4

+from tests.conftest import signup

+def _create_project(client, headers, title="Night Bus"):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+

+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title="Episode 1", order=1, summary="Opening scene"):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": order,
+            "story_summary": summary,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+

+def _create_cut(
+    client,
+    headers,
+    episode_id,
+    cut_order,
+    script,
+    selected_layout="single",
+    aspect_ratio="1:1",
+    dialogues=None,
+    appearing_characters=None,
+    image_path=None,
+):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": cut_order,
+            "script": script,
+            "selected_layout": selected_layout,
+            "aspect_ratio": aspect_ratio,
+            "dialogues": dialogues or [],
+            "appearing_characters": appearing_characters or [],
+            "image_path": image_path,
+        },

+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+

+def test_duplicate_episode_inserts_right_after_original_and_shifts_following_episodes(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Rainy Stop", order=1, summary="A bus arrives at midnight.")
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Next Stop", order=2, summary="The passengers board.")
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Last Stop", order=3, summary="End of the line.")
+
+    _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep1["id"],
+        cut_order=1,
+        script="Wide shot of the empty bus stop in the rain",
+        selected_layout="wide",
+        aspect_ratio="16:9",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Driver", "text": "Last bus tonight.", "type": "speech"}],
+        appearing_characters=[{"id": "char-driver", "name": "Driver"}],
+        image_path="http://storage.local/cuts/cut1.png",
+    )
+    _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep1["id"],
+        cut_order=2,
+        script="Close-up on the protagonist stepping aboard",
+        selected_layout="single",
+        aspect_ratio="9:16",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Mina", "text": "Where does this go?", "type": "thought"}],
+        appearing_characters=[{"id": "char-mina", "name": "Mina"}],
+        image_path="http://storage.local/cuts/cut2.png",
+    )
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/duplicate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    dup = r.json()
+
+    assert dup["id"] != ep1["id"]
+    assert dup["project_id"] == project["id"]
+    assert dup["title"] != ep1["title"]
+    assert ep1["title"] in dup["title"]
+    assert "copy" in dup["title"].lower()
+    assert dup["story_summary"] == "A bus arrives at midnight."
+    assert dup["episode_order"] == 2
+
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [ep1["id"], dup["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2, 3, 4]
+
+    orig_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep1['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    dup_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={dup['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert len(dup_cuts) == 2
+
+    for orig_cut, dup_cut in zip(orig_cuts, dup_cuts):
+        assert dup_cut["id"] != orig_cut["id"]
+        assert dup_cut["episode_id"] == dup["id"]
+        assert dup_cut["cut_order"] == orig_cut["cut_order"]
+        assert dup_cut["script"] == orig_cut["script"]
+        assert dup_cut["dialogues"] == orig_cut["dialogues"]
+        assert dup_cut["selected_layout"] == orig_cut["selected_layout"]
+        assert dup_cut["aspect_ratio"] == orig_cut["aspect_ratio"]
+        assert dup_cut["appearing_characters"] == orig_cut["appearing_characters"]
+        assert dup_cut["image_path"] == orig_cut["image_path"]
+

+def test_deleting_episode_closes_gap_and_keeps_contiguous_numbering(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 1", order=1)
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 2", order=2)
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 3", order=3)
+
+    # Duplicate Ep 2 -> goes to order 3, Ep 3 moves to order 4
+    dup2 = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    assert dup2["episode_order"] == 3
+
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listed] == [
+        (ep1["id"], 1),
+        (ep2["id"], 2),
+        (dup2["id"], 3),
+        (ep3["id"], 4),
+    ]
+
+    # Delete Ep 2 (order 2) -> closes the gap so dup2 becomes 2 and ep3 becomes 3
+    r = client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 204
+
+    listed_after_delete = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listed_after_delete] == [
+        (ep1["id"], 1),
+        (dup2["id"], 2),
+        (ep3["id"], 3),
+    ]
+
+    # Deleting the first episode renumbers remaining to 1, 2
+    r = client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 204
+
+    listed_after_first_delete = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listed_after_first_delete] == [
+        (dup2["id"], 1),
+        (ep3["id"], 2),
+    ]

+    project = _create_project(client, h_owner)

+    credits_before = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h_owner).json()[0]["credits"]
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/duplicate", headers=h_owner)

+    # Unknown episode gets 404

+def test_restore_deleted_episode_returns_it_with_cuts_at_previous_place(client):
+    h_owner = signup(client, email="restorer@example.com")
+    h_outsider = signup(client, email="other@example.com")
+
+    project = _create_project(client, h_owner)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h_owner, project["id"], title="Ep 1", order=1, summary="First")
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h_owner, project["id"], title="Ep 2", order=2, summary="Second")
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h_owner, project["id"], title="Ep 3", order=3, summary="Third")
+
+    _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h_owner,
+        ep2["id"],
+        cut_order=1,
+        script="Ep 2 cut 1",
+        selected_layout="wide",
+        aspect_ratio="16:9",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Mina", "text": "Wait!"}],
+        appearing_characters=[{"id": "c-mina", "name": "Mina"}],
+        image_path="http://storage.local/cuts/ep2_c1.png",
+    )
+    _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h_owner,
+        ep2["id"],
+        cut_order=2,
+        script="Ep 2 cut 2",
+        selected_layout="single",
+        aspect_ratio="1:1",
+    )
+
+    # Delete Ep 2 (had order 2); Ep 3 shifts up to order 2
+    r_del = client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h_owner)
+    assert r_del.status_code == 204
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h_owner).status_code == 404
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep2['id']}", headers=h_owner).json() == []
+
+    after_del = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h_owner).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in after_del] == [
+        (ep1["id"], 1),
+        (ep3["id"], 2),
+    ]
+
+    # Outsider cannot restore (404)
+    r_outsider = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/restore", headers=h_outsider)
+    assert r_outsider.status_code == 404
+
+    # Unknown episode gets 404
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{uuid4()}/restore", headers=h_owner).status_code == 404
+
+    # Workspace member restores Ep 2 -> comes back at order 2, Ep 3 shifts down to order 3
+    r_restore = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/restore", headers=h_owner)
+    assert r_restore.status_code == 200, r_restore.text
+    restored = r_restore.json()
+    assert restored["id"] == ep2["id"]
+    assert restored["title"] == "Ep 2"
+    assert restored["story_summary"] == "Second"
+    assert restored["episode_order"] == 2
+
+    after_restore = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h_owner).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in after_restore] == [
+        (ep1["id"], 1),
+        (ep2["id"], 2),
+        (ep3["id"], 3),
+    ]
+
+    restored_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep2['id']}", headers=h_owner).json()
+    assert [c["script"] for c in restored_cuts] == ["Ep 2 cut 1", "Ep 2 cut 2"]
+    assert restored_cuts[0]["dialogues"] == [{"speaker": "Mina", "text": "Wait!"}]
+    assert restored_cuts[0]["appearing_characters"] == [{"id": "c-mina", "name": "Mina"}]
+    assert restored_cuts[0]["image_path"] == "http://storage.local/cuts/ep2_c1.png"
+
